summary: Fortinet raised its 2026 revenue and billings guidance, now expecting FY2026 revenue of $8.125 billion to $8.215 billion and Q4 2026 revenue of $2.155 billion to $2.245 billion, with non-GAAP EPS of $0.93 to $0.95 for Q4 and $3.54 to $3.58 for the full year.
